note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The Snapchat account, its campaigns, ads, audiences, pixel and ids are invented too.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "snapchat-ads-manager" skill. Review my Snapchat Ads account for the last 30 days, tell me what to fix first and which ads to pause, write fresh headlines from my best ad, and draft a new sign-up campaign for our lookalike audience at $40 a day, starting next Monday, that sends people to example.com/signup/. Don't run anything yet.

account.name: Example Booking Software (Snapchat ad account)
account.business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)

date_range.window: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-27 (last 30 complete days in the account's time zone)

target_cost_per_result: not given, so each campaign's own cost per result in the window is used

brief.audience: the account's lookalike audience of people who signed up

get_ads.name: Video | Booked while you work | Stories
Video | Booked while you work | Retargeting
